text: Ⅰ. Acceptance Requirements and Duration Acceptance requirements: Students graduated from higher school with certain aquaculture knowledge. Duration: Full time for one year. Ⅱ.Training Objective According to aquaculture industry specialty and developing trend in Pakistan, combining the good geographic, climate and resource conditions in China, to train a professional technological team which can promote the aquaculture industry to develop healthily in Pakistan. In detail is through systemicly study the theoretical knowledge of seeds culture, raising, disease prevention and bait process etc. of fish, shrimp, crab, shell and sea cucumber and so on main aquaculture products and practical internship in real fish plant or pond, so as to master the skill and ability to do aquaculture and relevant industry independently. Through three-round enhancement and five combination, to realize the training objective of "the first year follow teachers, the second year lead lower classmates, the third year create and operate the own aquaculture business". Graduates will obtain two certificates: Graduation certificate on aquaculture and Certificate on career skill advanced technician.
